title: Expose a usable CodeGraph index for isolated VIXEN worktrees
body: The required codegraph explore query failed because this checkout had no .codegraph index and the tool said initialization is an owner decision, so I had to fall back to rg and source reads. Provide a maintained index or an authorized index setup for assigned worktrees.

title: Resolve GDB provisioning dependencies from the host Ubuntu release
body: The diagnostic configure command cmake --preset vixen-wsl-debug -DVIXEN_AUTO_PROVISION_GDB=ON could not provision the debugger because ProvisionGdb.cmake expects libpython3.12t64 while this host has Ubuntu resolute with Python 3.14. I manually downloaded and extracted gdb 17.1 and missing direct libraries into .gdb-deps, then added that directory to LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Detect the host package set or use the system debugger when compatible.

title: Default VIXEN worktree builds to a worktree-local FetchContent cache
body: Every queued configure and build needed VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE set to this worktree's .tmp/fetch per lane rules. Make the queue or preset supply this isolation setting automatically so each worker does not need to remember a manual environment export.

title: Cache pinned Vulkan SDK downloads across VIXEN worktrees
body: The first vixen-wsl-debug configure provisioned the pinned 1.4.350.1 Vulkan SDK into this worktree's VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk, downloading about 320 MB despite the shared machine caches. Reuse a validated global SDK archive or installation and link it into each lane to avoid repeating large setup downloads.
